verdict.rationale: Loops exposes a full REST API (Bearer-token auth, documented via openapi.json), typed SDKs, and a CLI explicitly designed to 'manage contacts, send events, trigger transactional emails, and test your integration, all from the terminal,' which together enable headless/backend/CI-style automation without UI interaction. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), and independent hands-on confirmation of CLI use in automated/non-interactive environments.
